transformer.source:
# TRANSFORMER_BEGIN
# A bounded lexical recognizer for the verified PG17.6 ASCII roles dump profile.
# It never executes SQL, never replaces global strings, and slices original bytes.
def scan_roles(raw):
 need(type(raw) is bytes and b'\x00' not in raw and all(c<128 for c in raw),'ROLE_SCRIPT_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED')
 n=len(raw);i=0;tokens=[];statements=[];metas=[];comments=[];restrict_key=None;restrict_seen=False;unrestrict_seen=False
 def token(kind,value,start,end):tokens.append({'kind':kind,'value':value,'start':start,'end':end})
 while i<n:
  c=raw[i]
  if c in b' \t\r\n\f\v':i+=1;continue
  if raw[i:i+2]==b'--':
   j=raw.find(b'\n',i+2);j=n if j<0 else j+1;comments.append([i,j]);i=j;continue
  if raw[i:i+2]==b'/*':
   start=i;depth=1;i+=2
   while i<n and depth:
    if raw[i:i+2]==b'/*':depth+=1;i+=2
    elif raw[i:i+2]==b'*/':depth-=1;i+=2
    else:i+=1
   need(depth==0,'ROLE_SCRIPT_TRUNCATED_COMMENT');comments.append([start,i]);continue
  if c==92:
   need(not tokens and raw[raw.rfind(b'\n',0,i)+1:i].strip()==b'','ROLE_SCRIPT_META_BOUNDARY_AMBIGUOUS')
   j=raw.find(b'\n',i);j=n if j<0 else j+1;line=raw[i:j].rstrip(b'\r\n')
   m=re.fullmatch(rb'\\(restrict|unrestrict) ([A-Za-z0-9]+)',line)
   need(m is not None,'ROLE_SCRIPT_META_UNSUPPORTED')
   name=m[1].decode();key=m[2].decode()
   if name=='restrict':
    need(not restrict_seen and not unrestrict_seen,'ROLE_SCRIPT_RESTRICT_ORDER');restrict_seen=True;restrict_key=key
   else:
    need(restrict_seen and not unrestrict_seen and key==restrict_key,'ROLE_SCRIPT_RESTRICT_PAIR');unrestrict_seen=True
   metas.append({'kind':name,'start':i,'end':j,'rawSha256':sha(raw[i:j])});i=j;continue
  if c==34:
   start=i;i+=1;value=[];closed=False
   while i<n:
    if raw[i]==34:
     if i+1<n and raw[i+1]==34:value.append(34);i+=2;continue
     i+=1;closed=True;break
    value.append(raw[i]);i+=1
   need(closed and value and len(value)<=63,'ROLE_SCRIPT_QUOTED_IDENTIFIER_INVALID')
   token('identifier',bytes(value).decode('ascii'),start,i);continue
  if c==39:
   start=i;i+=1;closed=False
   # Escaped/Unicode prefixed strings require another lexical profile.
   need(not(tokens and tokens[-1]['end']==start and tokens[-1]['kind']=='word'),'ROLE_SCRIPT_STRING_PREFIX_UNSUPPORTED')
   while i<n:
    need(raw[i]!=92,'ROLE_SCRIPT_BACKSLASH_STRING_UNSUPPORTED')
    if raw[i]==39:
     if i+1<n and raw[i+1]==39:i+=2;continue
     i+=1;closed=True;break
    i+=1
   need(closed,'ROLE_SCRIPT_TRUNCATED_STRING');token('string',None,start,i);continue
  if (65<=c<=90) or (97<=c<=122) or c==95:
   start=i;i+=1
   while i<n and (65<=raw[i]<=90 or 97<=raw[i]<=122 or 48<=raw[i]<=57 or raw[i] in b'_$'):i+=1
   token('word',raw[start:i].decode('ascii').lower(),start,i);continue
  if 48<=c<=57:
   start=i;i+=1
   while i<n and 48<=raw[i]<=57:i+=1
   token('number',raw[start:i].decode('ascii'),start,i);continue
  if c==59:
   need(tokens,'ROLE_SCRIPT_EMPTY_OR_AMBIGUOUS_STATEMENT')
   first=tokens[0];need(first['kind']=='word' and first['value'] in ['create','alter','grant','set','comment','security'],'ROLE_SCRIPT_STATEMENT_CLASS_UNSUPPORTED')
   start=first['start'];end=i+1
   item={'index':len(statements)+1,'start':start,'end':end,'sql':raw[start:end].decode('ascii'),'sqlSha256':sha(raw[start:end]),'tokens':tokens,'type':first['value'].upper(),'createRole':None,'hasInternalComment':any(a>=start and a<end for a,z in comments)}
   if first['value']=='create':
    need(len(tokens)==3 and tokens[1]['kind']=='word' and tokens[1]['value']=='role' and tokens[2]['kind'] in ['word','identifier'],'ROLE_SCRIPT_CREATE_FORM_UNSUPPORTED')
    item['createRole']=tokens[2]['value']
   statements.append(item);tokens=[];i+=1;continue
  if c in b'=,().-':token('punct',chr(c),i,i+1);i+=1;continue
  raise Stop('ROLE_SCRIPT_LEXICAL_AMBIGUITY')
 need(not tokens,'ROLE_SCRIPT_TRUNCATED_STATEMENT')
 need(restrict_seen==unrestrict_seen,'ROLE_SCRIPT_RESTRICT_UNCLOSED')
 return {'statements':statements,'metaCommands':metas,'comments':comments,'profile':'PG17_6_ASCII_ROLES_BOUNDARY_V1'}

def derive(raw,source_identity,destination_identity):
 name=source_identity.get('bootstrapName');need(type(name) is str and name and name.isascii() and len(name.encode())<=63,'SOURCE_BOOTSTRAP_PROVENANCE_INVALID')
 need(oid(source_identity.get('bootstrapOid'))==10 and source_identity.get('serverVersionNum')==170006,'SOURCE_BOOTSTRAP_PROVENANCE_INVALID')
 need(destination_identity.get('bootstrapName')==name and oid(destination_identity.get('bootstrapOid'))==10 and destination_identity.get('serverVersionNum')==170006,'DESTINATION_BOOTSTRAP_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
 need(not re.search(rb'\bPASSWORD\s+\S+',raw,re.I),'ROLE_PASSWORD')
 parsed=scan_roles(raw);hits=[s for s in parsed['statements'] if s['createRole']==name]
 need(len(hits)>0,'BOOTSTRAP_CREATE_ZERO_MATCH');need(len(hits)==1,'BOOTSTRAP_CREATE_MULTIPLE_MATCH')
 item=hits[0];need(not item['hasInternalComment'],'BOOTSTRAP_CREATE_INTERNAL_COMMENT_AMBIGUITY')
 a,z=item['start'],item['end'];output=raw[:a]+raw[z:]
 need(output[:a]==raw[:a] and output[a:]==raw[z:],'DERIVATION_BYTE_PRESERVATION')
 return output,{'profile':parsed['profile'],'sourceBootstrapIdentity':copy.deepcopy(source_identity),'destinationBootstrapIdentity':copy.deepcopy(destination_identity),
  'originalBytes':len(raw),'originalSha256':sha(raw),'derivedBytes':len(output),'derivedSha256':sha(output),'matchCount':1,'bootstrapIdentifier':name,
  'removedSpan':{'startByteInclusive':a,'endByteExclusive':z,'statementIndexOneBased':item['index'],'lineOneBased':raw[:a].count(b'\n')+1},
  'removedExactStatement':raw[a:z].decode('ascii'),'removedStatementSha256':sha(raw[a:z]),'prefixSha256':sha(raw[:a]),'suffixSha256':sha(raw[z:]),
  'prefixByteExact':True,'suffixByteExact':True,'originalNeverModified':True,'allOtherStatementsAndCommentsPreserved':True,'originalMetaCommands':parsed['metaCommands']}
# TRANSFORMER_END
